scope: Rebuild helpers, provenance, runtime verifier; no live service/model/GPU inspection

findings.title: Prepared source verification ignores non-overlay build inputs
findings.reproduction: Actual --verify exited 0 after adding #error to temporary ggml-quants.c and after deleting include/llama.h. Altered overlay header correctly failed.
findings.impact: A reused prepared tree can compile a different core implementation, or fail later due missing headers, after passing the baseline preflight.
findings.minimal_fix: Derive and verify the complete expected prepared tree from trusted vendor manifest, ORIGINS overlays and GLUE, including missing and unexpected source files.
findings.limitation: No changed source was compiled; no claim that the current committed tree is corrupt.

findings.title: UI build OFF leaves remote prebuilt UI provisioning ON
findings.classification: configuration confirmed; branch reproduced with download primitive stubbed
findings.reproduction: Fresh configure has BUILD_UI=OFF and USE_PREBUILT_UI=ON. Instrumented actual UI script reaches requested-version and latest checksum fetch branches; OFF/OFF reaches neither.
findings.impact: Unpinned external UI bytes and network availability/stale local assets can change the server build even when engine source is frozen.
findings.minimal_fix: Set LLAMA_USE_PREBUILT_UI=OFF as well for this external-Open-WebUI profile, or separately pin and hash UI assets without latest fallback.
findings.limitation: No network download or final CUDA/server build was executed. The fixture requested b1 explicitly.

findings.title: Reusing work/build preserves unlisted CMake experiment options
findings.classification: reproduced in actual prepared-project CMake configure
findings.reproduction: Seeded GGML_SANITIZE_ADDRESS=ON and GGML_AMX_TILE=ON remain ON after plan options reapplied; compile_commands contains -fsanitize=address and -mamx-tile. Fresh configure has both OFF.
findings.impact: The named frozen Ivy Bridge build can silently differ in instrumentation, ISA options and dependencies according to earlier local experiments.
findings.minimal_fix: Default to a new configurable build directory; validate an explicit reuse manifest; persist compiler/CMake versions, effective cache, compile commands and output hashes.
findings.limitation: CUDA was disabled for configure because toolkit is unavailable; target build and actual Ivy Bridge execution were not tested.

findings.title: Runtime verification validates listed bytes, not trusted baseline inventory
findings.reproduction: Synthetic valid listed files pass and altered listed bytes fail; an unlisted bin/libgomp.so.1 and an empty files manifest are accepted.
findings.impact: Success cannot alone establish expected baseline completeness or the dependencies chosen by the dynamic loader.
findings.minimal_fix: Verify archive hash against trusted profile, support expected-manifest/schema/inventory checks, and separately capture actual runtime DSO identities.
findings.limitation: No evidence the published release is corrupt. Fixture files are not executable ELF and were never loaded.

non_findings: LLAMA_BUILD_MTMD=OFF is a standalone option; tools/server still links mtmd through the tools build.
The repo explicitly marks the full reconstructed CUDA/server build as unverified; this review does not treat that disclosure as a hidden defect.
